## 27022802 — Linear Induction motor

a linear induction motor is an electromechanical device that converts electrical energy into linear motion. It operates on the principle of electromagnetic induction, utilizing alternating current to generate a magnetic field that interacts with the conductive surface of the load, producing linear thrust. This type of motor is characterized by its simplicity, robustness, and ability to provide smooth motion without the need for mechanical transmission systems. It is commonly used in applications requiring high-speed transport, automated systems, and industrial processes where precise linear movement is essential. The technology is distinct from other linear motor types, such as those employing direct current or synchronous operation, thus offering unique operational advantages in specific settings.

Linear DC motors are commonly used in applications requiring linear actuation, such as in automation systems, robotics, and various industrial processes, where reliable and accurate linear motion is essential.

## 27022804 — Linear stepping motor

This results in the rotor moving in defined steps along a linear path. The linear stepping motor is commonly utilized in applications requiring precise control of position and speed, such as in automation, robotics, and CNC machinery. Its design allows for open-loop control, making it suitable for various industrial and consumer applications where high accuracy is essential.

## 27022807 — Linear ultrasonic motor

a linear ultrasonic motor is a type of electromechanical device that utilizes ultrasonic vibrations to generate linear motion. This technology operates based on the principle of converting electrical energy into mechanical motion through the use of high-frequency sound waves. The motor typically consists of a stator and a slider, where the stator generates ultrasonic waves that create a standing wave pattern, allowing the slider to move along a predetermined path. Linear ultrasonic motors are known for their high precision, rapid response times, and ability to achieve smooth motion without the need for traditional gears or mechanical linkages. They are widely utilized in applications requiring compact size, lightweight design, and precise control, such as in robotics, optical devices, and medical equipment.

## 27024401 — Shunt

a shunt is a specialized electrical component designed to allow the flow of current while providing a low-resistance path for a portion of the total current. It is commonly used for measuring and monitoring electrical currents in various applications. Shunts are characterized by their ability to create a voltage drop proportional to the current flowing through them, enabling precise measurement and control. These devices are essential in power management systems, instrumentation, and electronic devices where accurate current measurement is critical. Shunts can vary in design, materials, and specifications to meet the requirements of different electrical systems and applications.

Its construction typically includes robust insulation and advanced cooling mechanisms to maintain operational integrity under demanding conditions. ## 27040301 — Switching power supply

a switching power supply is an electrical device that converts electrical power efficiently through the process of switching regulation. It operates by rapidly turning the input power on and off, allowing for the control of output voltage and current. This type of power supply typically features high efficiency, compact design, and the capability to handle varying load conditions. Unlike traditional linear power supplies, switching power supplies utilize high-frequency components to minimize energy loss and heat generation. They are widely used in various applications including consumer electronics, telecommunications, and industrial equipment, providing stable and reliable power to a range of devices while differing in operational characteristics from AC adapters.

---

## 27040302 — AC adapter

a device designed to convert alternating current (AC) from a power source into a direct current (DC) suitable for powering electronic devices. This type of adapter is specifically utilized to provide the appropriate voltage and current levels required for operation, ensuring compatibility with the intended electronic components. Unlike switching power supplies, which use high-frequency switches to regulate output, this device typically employs a more straightforward conversion mechanism, making it ideal for various applications where a stable and reliable DC power source is necessary. Its design often includes features such as over-voltage protection and thermal management to ensure safe and efficient performance.

---

## 27040601 — UPS On-Line (double conversion)

a type of power supply system designed to provide uninterruptible power by converting incoming alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC) and then back to AC, ensuring a continuous and stable power output. This system operates through a double conversion process, which enhances power quality and protects connected equipment from voltage fluctuations, surges, and other electrical disturbances. Characterized by its ability to maintain power supply during outages and its suitability for critical applications, this type of power supply is distinct from other variants that may offer different operational methodologies or levels of protection. It is commonly utilized in environments where power reliability is crucial, including data centers, medical facilities, and industrial applications.

---

## 27040602 — UPS Off-Line (standby)

a type of uninterruptible power supply designed to provide emergency power to connected devices during outages or disturbances in the main power supply. This system operates by switching to a backup power source when the primary power fails, ensuring that there is no interruption in service. Unlike other variants that maintain continuous power through active conversion processes, this system relies on a standby mechanism that engages only when necessary. It is commonly used in environments where temporary power loss can disrupt operations, providing a reliable and cost-effective solution for maintaining equipment functionality during power interruptions.

---

## 27040603 — UPS Line-interactive (mains parallel)

a line-interactive uninterruptible power supply (UPS) is a type of power protection device that enhances the reliability and quality of electrical power supplied to connected equipment. It operates by continuously regulating voltage levels while providing backup power during outages. This system typically includes an automatic voltage regulator, allowing it to adjust and stabilize input voltage fluctuations. In the event of a power failure, it seamlessly switches to battery power to ensure uninterrupted operation of critical devices. This classification specifically refers to units that are designed to operate in parallel with the mains supply, distinguishing them from other UPS types that utilize different operational methods, such as double conversion systems that provide constant power conditioning or standby systems that activate only during outages.

---

## 27050902 — Terminal (accumulator)

this classification pertains to devices specifically designed for the connection and management of energy storage systems. These items serve as critical interfaces within electrical circuits, facilitating the transfer of electrical energy to and from accumulators or batteries. They play a vital role in ensuring efficient operation and safety of energy storage solutions by enhancing connectivity and performance. This classification encompasses various designs and functionalities tailored to meet the requirements of energy storage applications, ensuring compatibility with different battery types and configurations. These devices are essential for maintaining optimal performance and reliability in energy systems, enabling effective energy management and integration into broader electrical frameworks.

---

## 27050903 — Strain relief clamp (accumulator)

a device designed to secure and protect flexible cables or wires connected to energy storage systems, ensuring that stress is relieved from the connections. This component prevents damage caused by movement or tension on the cables, enhancing the longevity and reliability of the electrical connections. It typically features a design that accommodates various cable sizes and is made from durable materials to withstand environmental factors. The strain relief clamp is essential for maintaining the integrity of the connection points in energy storage applications, contributing to safe and efficient operation.

---

## 27050904 — Diagnostic plug (accumulator)

a diagnostic plug serves as a specialized interface designed to facilitate communication between diagnostic equipment and the electrical system of an energy storage device. This component plays a critical role in monitoring and assessing the performance and health of the storage unit, ensuring optimal functionality. It enables the retrieval of vital operational data, such as voltage levels, charge status, and overall condition of the accumulator. By providing a reliable connection point for diagnostics, this device aids in maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of energy storage solutions. Its design is tailored to withstand the specific environmental and operational conditions associated with energy storage applications.

---

## 27050905 — Battery monitor

a device designed to monitor the performance and status of batteries, providing critical information such as charge level, voltage, temperature, and overall health. It typically offers real-time data to optimize battery usage, enhance safety, and prolong battery life. The device may feature various monitoring technologies, including analog and digital displays, connectivity options for external devices, and alerts for maintenance or operational issues. This type of equipment is essential in applications where battery efficiency and reliability are paramount, ensuring that users can make informed decisions about battery management and maintenance.

---

## 27050906 — Pile (accumulator)

a type of energy storage device designed to accumulate and store electrical energy for later use. This device operates by converting electrical energy into chemical energy during the charging process and releasing it during discharge. It is typically used in various applications, providing power supply stability and energy management. The construction and materials involved are aimed at enhancing energy density, cycle life, and efficiency. This category includes specific variations that may differ in size, capacity, and technology, adapted for diverse operational environments and requirements.

---

## 27050907 — Water refill system (accumulator)

a water refill system designed for accumulators serves as a mechanism to automatically replenish the water levels within the battery cells. This system ensures optimal performance and longevity of the accumulator by maintaining the necessary electrolyte levels, thereby preventing damage due to dehydration. It typically includes components that facilitate the transfer of water from an external source to the accumulator, ensuring a consistent supply without the need for manual intervention. This system contributes to the overall efficiency and reliability of the accumulator while minimizing maintenance efforts. It is distinct from other components associated with accumulators, which serve different functions such as protection, connectivity, monitoring, and containment.

---

## 27050908 — Electrolyte circulating system

System within accumulators that ensures that the ion-containing liquid remains in continuous motion to ensure an even distribution of ions and optimize performance.

---

## 27050909 — Connector technique (battery/accumulator)

a category that encompasses devices and systems used to establish electrical connections within battery and accumulator applications, ensuring secure and efficient communication between components. This classification includes items designed to facilitate the transfer of electrical energy, manage voltage levels, and maintain connectivity under various operational conditions. The focus is on components that play a critical role in the functionality and reliability of battery systems, characterized by their ability to enhance performance while adhering to safety standards. Products in this category are essential for optimizing the operation and longevity of energy storage solutions.

## 27050910 — Connecting technique (Battery)

this category encompasses various methods and devices designed to establish electrical connections within battery systems. This classification is distinct from other connection-related components that serve different functions within battery systems, focusing solely on those that enable and optimize the interconnection of battery units and related accessories. a battery box is a protective enclosure designed to house and secure batteries, typically used in various applications requiring power storage and management. Additionally, it may feature ventilation systems to prevent overheating and allow for proper airflow, ensuring optimal battery performance and longevity. Battery boxes are essential in various settings, including automotive, renewable energy systems, and portable power solutions, offering a reliable means to organize and protect battery units while facilitating easy access for maintenance and replacement.

## 27080202 — Switch-disconnector indoor (high voltage)

a switch-disconnector designed for indoor use in high voltage applications serves to isolate electrical circuits and ensure safety during maintenance or emergencies. This device is equipped to handle voltages exceeding 52 kilovolts and is utilized primarily in electrical distribution systems to provide a clear physical separation between sections of the system. Unlike circuit breakers, which automatically interrupt current flow during overload or fault conditions, the switch-disconnector requires manual operation to achieve disconnection. This specificity allows for the safe maintenance of electrical equipment and the protection of personnel, making it a critical component in high voltage electrical installations. Its construction is tailored for indoor environments, ensuring durability and reliability under controlled conditions.

## 27080801 — Isolator (>=110kV)

a device designed to provide electrical isolation in high-voltage systems operating at or above 110 kilovolts. This apparatus ensures that electrical circuits can be safely de-energized for maintenance or inspection, preventing unintended energization. It is capable of interrupting current flow and is utilized in substations and distribution networks to enhance operational safety and reliability. The isolator is specifically engineered for high-voltage applications and is distinct from other switching devices, such as earthing switches, which serve different functions in the management of electrical systems.

---

## 27080802 — Earthing switch (>=110kV)

a device designed to safely connect or disconnect electrical equipment from the electrical network while ensuring the earthing of the system. It operates at voltages equal to or exceeding 110 kilovolts and is specifically engineered to handle high voltage applications. This device is primarily used for grounding purposes, facilitating maintenance and protection of electrical systems by preventing potential electric shock and ensuring the safety of personnel and equipment. Its design allows for reliable operation under high-voltage conditions, distinguishing it from similar devices that do not incorporate earthing functionality.

---

## 27080901 — Isolator (>1kV,<110kV)

a component designed to interrupt current flow and isolate electrical circuits operating within specified voltage limits that exceed 1 kilovolt but are less than 110 kilovolts. This device is intended for use in electrical installations to ensure safety and maintenance by providing a means to disconnect portions of the system from the power supply while ensuring reliable performance under high voltage conditions. It is characterized by its ability to withstand electrical stresses and is often utilized in substations and switchgear applications where high voltage isolation is necessary.

---

## 27080902 — Earth switch (>1kV,<110kV)

a device designed to safely disconnect electrical circuits while providing grounding capabilities, specifically utilized in applications with voltage levels exceeding 1 kilovolt and below 110 kilovolts. This equipment is essential for ensuring the safety and reliability of electrical systems by allowing for controlled maintenance and fault isolation. It features mechanisms that enable grounding during operation, thereby minimizing the risk of electrical shock and equipment damage. The device is engineered to withstand the operational demands and environmental conditions typical in high-voltage settings, ensuring durability and performance in various industrial and utility applications.

---

## 27081002 — Implementation (insulator, post insulator)

this category encompasses products designed to facilitate the installation and support of electrical insulators, specifically those intended for use in various electrical systems. These items are characterized by their ability to effectively secure and maintain the positioning of insulators, ensuring operational safety and efficiency. The classification specifically excludes related items that serve different functions, such as those designed for bus bar applications, cable management, or other insulator types. The focus is on components that directly contribute to the stability and functionality of post insulators in electrical infrastructure.

---

## 27081003 — Bus bar holder (insulator, post insulator)

device used in electrical engineering to open a circuit and simultaneously limit or interrupt the current flowing through it via an integrated fuse in order to ensure protection in the event of overload or short circuits.

---

## 27081004 — Cable holder (insulator, post insulator)

a device designed to securely support and maintain the position of electrical cables while ensuring electrical insulation. This item is primarily used in electrical installations to prevent contact between cables and conductive materials, providing stability and safety. It plays a crucial role in minimizing the risk of electrical faults and ensuring the reliability of electrical systems. The design may vary based on application requirements, including factors such as load capacity, environmental conditions, and compatibility with different cable types. This category encompasses various types of holders that serve specific insulation functions, ensuring the safe and effective operation of electrical networks.

---

## 27081005 — Insulator

an insulating device designed to support and isolate electrical conductors, ensuring the safe and efficient transmission of electrical energy. This component serves to prevent electrical leakage and maintain the integrity of the electrical system by providing a barrier against unwanted electrical discharge. Typically made from materials with high dielectric strength, these devices are essential in various applications, including overhead power lines and substations, where they mitigate the risk of electrical faults and enhance system reliability. They may vary in shape, size, and design to accommodate different installation environments and operational requirements, contributing to the overall safety and functionality of electrical infrastructure.

---

## 27130704 — Protection against heat

## 27130901 — Transformer protection (complete)

a comprehensive assembly designed to safeguard transformer systems by providing essential protective measures against various electrical faults and abnormalities. This collection of components is engineered to ensure the operational integrity of transformer installations, particularly within the frequency range of 50-60 Hz. It encompasses all necessary devices and mechanisms required to detect, isolate, and mitigate potential hazards that may compromise the performance and safety of transformers. This classification is distinctly differentiated from other protective measures, such as those specifically aimed at differential protection, earth fault protection, or gas alarm systems, highlighting its unique role in transformer safety and reliability.

---

## 27130902 — Transformer differential protection

Safety system for electrical installations that automatically detects an overload or malfunction in the transformer and switches it off quickly in critical conditions such as short circuits to prevent damage.

---

## 27130903 — Transformer earth fault protection

a protective device designed to detect and respond to earth faults in transformer systems operating within the frequency range of 50-60 Hz. This device monitors the insulation integrity of the transformer and its associated electrical circuits, ensuring safety by identifying ground faults that could lead to equipment damage or operational hazards. Upon detection of an earth fault, it activates protective measures to isolate the affected section, thereby safeguarding both the transformer and the overall electrical installation. This classification is distinct from other protective technologies that encompass broader or different functionalities within transformer systems.

---

## 27130904 — Transformer Buchholz gas alarm relay

a device designed to monitor the gas levels within a transformer, specifically utilizing a Buchholz relay mechanism. This apparatus is integral to transformer protection installations operating within the frequency range of 50-60 Hz. It functions by detecting gas accumulation, which can indicate potential faults or failures in the transformer, thereby providing an early warning system to prevent further damage. This device is distinct from other protective measures, focusing specifically on gas monitoring, in contrast to comprehensive transformer protection solutions, differential protection systems, or earth fault protection mechanisms.

---

## 27150101 — Magnetothermal (PAT)

magnetothermal refers to a category of products or services that utilize thermal properties in conjunction with magnetic fields to perform specific functions. This classification encompasses various applications where heat generation or heat transfer is influenced or controlled by magnetic forces. The items within this category are distinct from related classifications that focus on other mechanisms such as pneumatic or mechanical interactions with magnetic fields. The technologies associated with this classification are often used in specialized industrial, scientific, or medical applications, emphasizing the integration of thermal management and magnetic properties to achieve desired operational outcomes.

## 27150103 — Magnetomechanical (PAT)

this classification encompasses devices or systems that utilize magnetomechanical principles for the measurement or control of physical properties related to paramagnetism. These assets are characterized by their ability to interact with magnetic fields, facilitating precise measurements of various parameters in specific applications. The focus is on the integration of mechanical components that react to magnetic forces, enabling enhanced functionality in scientific and industrial contexts. This classification distinguishes itself from others that employ different underlying physical principles, such as thermal or pneumatic interactions, ensuring clarity in the categorization of related technologies and products.

## 27150104 — NMR (PAT)

this classification encompasses a specific category of assets related to measurement techniques that utilize paramagnetic properties for analyzing the concentration of gases, particularly oxygen. The focus is on innovative methodologies that leverage magnetic susceptibility variations in response to changes in gas composition. This category distinguishes itself through unique operational principles and applications, providing essential data for various industrial and scientific needs. The assets classified here are characterized by their precision and reliability in monitoring oxygen levels, which is crucial for numerous processes, including environmental analysis, medical applications, and industrial operations. The classification is designed to organize these assets based on their specific function and technology, ensuring clarity and ease of identification for users.

## 27150201 — Atomic absorption spectroscope (PAT)

Analytical method that uses the absorption of light by free atoms to determine the concentration of certain metals in a sample, often used in laboratories for environmental analysis and chemistry.

---

## 27150202 — Dispersive UV-VIS (PAT)

a category of analytical devices designed to measure the intensity of light in the ultraviolet and visible regions of the electromagnetic spectrum after it has interacted with a sample. These instruments utilize dispersive optics to separate light into its component wavelengths, allowing for the quantitative and qualitative analysis of materials based on their absorption or transmission characteristics. The technology is essential in various applications, including environmental monitoring, chemical analysis, and quality control in manufacturing, providing insights into the composition and properties of substances. The classification distinguishes this category from other types of spectroscopic instruments that utilize different methodologies or spectral ranges.

---

## 27150203 — Dispersive (N)IR (PAT)

this classification encompasses devices designed for the analysis of fluids through the use of dispersive near-infrared spectroscopy technology. These analytical instruments leverage the absorption and scattering of infrared light to identify and quantify the components present in various liquid samples. They are utilized across multiple industries, including pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, and environmental monitoring, for their ability to provide rapid and non-destructive analysis. Their functionality is distinguished from other spectroscopic techniques by their specific application of dispersive optics, which facilitates the separation of light into its component wavelengths, enabling detailed spectral analysis of fluid samples.

---

## 27150204 — FT(N)IR (PAT)

a category designated for analytical devices specifically designed for the evaluation and measurement of fluid properties through infrared spectroscopy techniques. This classification encompasses instruments that utilize near-infrared (NIR) or Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) methodologies to analyze the composition of various liquids or gases. These devices provide insights into chemical structures and concentrations by interpreting the absorption of infrared light, allowing users to perform qualitative and quantitative assessments. The focus is on applications relevant to fluid analysis, distinguishing these instruments from other types of spectroscopic devices that may target solid materials or employ different spectroscopic methods for analysis.

---

## 27150205 — X-Ray fluorescence (PAT)

a specialized analytical instrument designed to determine the elemental composition of materials through the application of X-ray fluorescence technology. It utilizes high-energy X-rays to excite atoms in a sample, causing them to emit characteristic secondary X-rays that are measured to identify and quantify the elements present. This device is particularly useful in various fields, including material science, environmental analysis, and quality control, due to its non-destructive nature and ability to analyze a wide range of samples, including solids, liquids, and powders. The technology provides rapid and accurate results, making it an essential tool for precise elemental analysis.

---

## 27150206 — Fluorescence (PAT)

this classification refers to devices designed to analyze the fluorescence properties of substances. These instruments utilize the phenomenon of fluorescence, where a substance absorbs light at a specific wavelength and then re-emits it at a longer wavelength. This analysis technique is critical for various applications, including environmental monitoring, material identification, and biochemical assays. The devices in this category are distinguished by their specific methodologies and technologies, which enable precise measurement of fluorescence signals. They are commonly employed in laboratories and industrial settings to provide insights into the chemical composition and properties of different materials based on their fluorescence characteristics.

---

## 27150207 — Chemoluminescence (PAT)

a specialized analytical instrument designed to measure the intensity of light emitted by a chemical reaction that occurs in a sample, typically involving the release of energy in the form of light. This technique is utilized to assess various fluid properties, enabling the detection and quantification of specific substances within the sample. The instrument operates based on the principles of chemiluminescence, where the light produced is directly proportional to the concentration of the analyte present. This classification encompasses devices that are distinct from other analytical techniques that rely on different mechanisms of light interaction, such as absorption or scattering, thus providing unique insights into the composition and characteristics of fluid samples.

---

## 27150208 — Raman-spectroscopy (PAT)

this classification encompasses analytical instruments that utilize Raman spectroscopy techniques for the analysis of materials. These instruments are employed to identify molecular compositions and structures by measuring the inelastic scattering of monochromatic light, typically from a laser source. They are extensively used in various fields such as chemistry, biology, and materials science for qualitative and quantitative analysis. The technology enables users to obtain detailed information about molecular vibrations, crystal structures, and chemical interactions without the need for extensive sample preparation. The devices classified under this category are distinguished by their specific operational principles and applications that set them apart from other spectroscopic methods, focusing particularly on the unique capabilities offered by Raman scattering.

---

## 27150209 — Laser-spectroscopy (PAT)

this category encompasses analytical instruments that utilize laser technology for spectroscopy applications. These devices are designed to analyze the composition and properties of various substances by measuring the interaction of laser light with matter. The equipment typically provides high sensitivity and precision in detecting and quantifying specific components within a sample. The instruments in this category are distinct from other optical and non-optical spectroscopic techniques, each employing unique methodologies and principles for analysis. Applications may include quality control, environmental monitoring, and research in various scientific fields, making them valuable tools in both industrial and laboratory settings.

---

## 27150210 — Microwave spectroscope (PAT)

a device utilized for the analysis of materials through the interaction of microwave radiation with substances, enabling the identification and quantification of various components within a sample. This instrument operates by measuring the spectral response of a sample when subjected to microwave energy, providing insights into its chemical and physical properties. Its application is essential in fields requiring precise fluid analysis, offering distinct measurement capabilities that set it apart from other analytical techniques focused on different wavelengths or methods of excitation. The technology serves a critical role in both research and industrial settings, enhancing the understanding of material characteristics and behaviors.

The measurement technique utilized is distinct from other methodologies that involve solid analysis, non-dispersive infrared measurement, optical density of smoke, and other turbidity measurement techniques based on scattered light. ## 27150401 — Refractometer (PAT)

a refractometer is an analytical instrument designed to measure the refractive index of a substance, which can provide valuable information about its concentration and composition. This device operates on the principle of light refraction, allowing users to determine how much light bends when passing through a sample. Refractometers are commonly used in various industries, including food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and chemical manufacturing, to ensure product quality and consistency. The specific category of refractometers differentiated in this context is tailored for particular applications, setting it apart from similar instruments such as polarimeters, which measure the rotation of polarized light passing through a sample.

## 27150501 — Magnetic sector MS (PAT)

a specialized instrument designed for the analysis of mass-to-charge ratios of ions, utilizing a magnetic field to separate ions based on their trajectories. It is particularly suited for applications requiring high-resolution mass analysis and is distinguished by its operational principles and configurations, which differentiate it from other mass analysis technologies. This classification encompasses various configurations and enhancements that optimize performance for specific analytical applications.

## 27150503 — Time-of-flight MS (PAT)

a time-of-flight mass spectrometer is an analytical instrument used to measure the mass-to-charge ratio of ions. It operates by accelerating ions through a drift region and measuring the time it takes for them to reach a detector. This method allows for high-resolution mass analysis and is particularly useful for identifying and quantifying complex mixtures. The time-of-flight technique differs from other mass spectrometry methods by its unique approach to ion detection and analysis, making it suitable for various applications in fields such as chemistry, biochemistry, and pharmaceuticals. Its ability to provide rapid analysis and high sensitivity makes it a valuable tool for researchers and industries requiring precise mass measurements.

## 27150601 — Gas chromatography (PAT)

a method utilized for separating and analyzing compounds that can be vaporized without decomposition. This technique involves the use of a mobile phase (gas) that carries the sample through a column packed with a stationary phase. The components of the sample interact differently with the stationary phase, leading to their separation based on volatility and affinity. It is widely used in various fields, including chemistry and biochemistry, for qualitative and quantitative analysis of complex mixtures. This method is particularly effective for volatile and semi-volatile substances, offering high resolution and sensitivity.

---

## 27150602 — HPLC (PAT)

a specialized analytical technique utilized for the separation, identification, and quantification of compounds within a mixture. This method employs high-performance liquid chromatography principles, leveraging pressure to push solvents through a column packed with stationary phase material. It is particularly effective in analyzing complex samples, including those in pharmaceutical, biochemical, and environmental applications. This technique is often integrated with process analytical technology, enabling real-time monitoring and control of manufacturing processes. The high resolution and sensitivity associated with this method make it suitable for detecting trace levels of substances, facilitating quality assurance and compliance in various industries.

---

## 27150603 — GPC (PAT)

this category encompasses a specific subset of analytical techniques used for the separation and analysis of complex mixtures. These methods are characterized by their ability to isolate individual components within a sample based on various physical or chemical properties. The focus here is on processes that utilize innovative approaches to enhance separation efficiency and resolution, particularly in the context of pharmaceuticals and biotechnological applications. This classification distinguishes itself from other separation techniques by its unique methodology and application, making it essential for researchers and professionals seeking to achieve precise and reliable analytical results in their work.

---

## 27150604 — Electrophoresis (PAT)

a method or technique used in laboratories for the separation and analysis of charged particles, typically involving the movement of ions or molecules through a medium under the influence of an electric field. This process allows for the differentiation of substances based on their size, charge, or other physicochemical properties. Applications include the purification of biomolecules, analysis of nucleic acids, and the characterization of proteins, enabling researchers to study complex biological samples with precision. The method is distinct from other separation techniques, emphasizing its specific role in electrophoretic applications within scientific research and diagnostics.

---

## 27150605 — Field flow fractionation (PAT)

field flow fractionation refers to a separation technique that utilizes a flow field to separate particles or macromolecules based on their size, shape, or other physical properties. This method allows for the analysis of a wide range of samples, including biological macromolecules and nanoparticles, providing high resolution and sensitivity. The technique operates by manipulating fluid dynamics within a channel, leading to differential migration of components under the influence of an external force, such as gravitational, thermal, or electric fields. Field flow fractionation is particularly valuable in applications requiring the characterization of complex mixtures and is essential in research and quality control across various scientific and industrial fields.

---

## 27180206 — Shunting distributor (complete)

a complete shunting distributor is a device designed to manage and distribute electrical or data signals within a network infrastructure. It serves as an integral component in organizing and directing connections between various equipment within a floor-standing enclosure, ensuring efficient signal flow and minimizing interference. This type of distributor is typically housed within a robust framework that supports optimal thermal management and protection for sensitive components. Its design incorporates features that facilitate easy access for maintenance and upgrades, while promoting effective cable management to enhance overall system performance. The complete shunting distributor is distinguished from other enclosures by its specific functionality in signal routing rather than merely providing protective housing for network equipment.

---

## 27180207 — Network/server enclosure

a network/server enclosure refers to a protective housing designed specifically for the organization and management of networking equipment and servers. This structure ensures optimal airflow, cooling, and accessibility, while providing security against physical damage and unauthorized access. Typically floor-standing, these enclosures are equipped with features such as adjustable mounting rails, cable management systems, and ventilation options. They are distinct from other types of enclosures, offering tailored solutions for the unique requirements of networking and server environments. The design and functionality of these enclosures support the efficient operation and maintenance of critical IT infrastructure.

---

## 27180208 — Network cabinet

a network cabinet is a specialized enclosure designed to securely house and protect networking equipment, servers, and associated hardware. It provides an organized and efficient space for the installation of various components, ensuring optimal airflow and cooling while minimizing physical damage or interference. These cabinets are typically floor-standing, equipped with features such as adjustable racks, cable management systems, and locking doors for enhanced security. Unlike other types of enclosures, a network cabinet is specifically tailored for networking applications, distinguishing it from complete shunting distributors and general network or server enclosures.

---

## 27200101 — Receiving clock

a device specifically designed to accurately measure and display time, often featuring precise synchronization capabilities. This tool is utilized in various applications where timing is critical, ensuring that operations are conducted in a timely manner. It may include functionalities such as alarms, timers, and other features that enhance its utility in monitoring and regulating time-dependent processes. This category is distinct from other time-measuring devices by its specific design and intended use cases, focusing on receiving and processing time signals for enhanced accuracy.

---

## 27200102 — Stop watch

Device for measuring time intervals that starts, stops and can be reset at the touch of a button, frequently used in sports and science.

---

## 27200104 — Radio clock

a device designed to display the time and often incorporates additional features such as alarm functions or radio reception capabilities. Typically utilized for personal timekeeping, it may include functionalities that allow synchronization with radio signals for enhanced accuracy. This type of appliance is characterized by its ability to provide both visual and auditory notifications regarding time, making it suitable for various environments, including homes, offices, and public spaces. The design may vary in form and style, catering to diverse aesthetic preferences and practical requirements.

---

## 27200105 — Master clock, signal clock

a precise timekeeping device designed to maintain and distribute synchronized time signals to other devices or systems. This type of clock serves as a central reference for accurate time measurement and coordination, ensuring consistency across various applications. It typically includes features that allow it to communicate with other time-dependent instruments, facilitating synchronization in environments where timing accuracy is critical. Unlike other timekeeping devices, this instrument is specifically tailored for applications requiring master time control and signal dissemination, differentiating it from standard clocks and timers that serve individual or localized functions.

---

## 27200106 — Wall clock

a wall clock is a timekeeping device designed to be mounted on a vertical surface, such as a wall. It typically features a circular or rectangular face with hour and minute markers, and often includes a second hand for precise time measurement. Wall clocks can be powered by various mechanisms, including quartz movements or traditional clockwork, and may display time in analog or digital formats. They serve both functional and decorative purposes, enhancing the aesthetic of a space while providing an easy way to monitor the time from a distance. Unlike other timekeeping devices, wall clocks are primarily intended for stationary use and are characterized by their visibility in larger rooms or open areas.

---

## 27200107 — Table clock

a timekeeping device designed to be placed on a flat surface, typically featuring a visible clock face or digital display. This device is primarily used for measuring and indicating time, often with additional functionalities such as alarms or timers. It serves both practical and decorative purposes, making it suitable for various settings, including homes, offices, and public areas. The design may vary widely, incorporating different styles, materials, and technologies to meet aesthetic preferences and functional requirements.

---

## 27200108 — Alarm clock

a device designed to emit sound or visual signals at predetermined times to alert users, typically used for waking up or reminding individuals of scheduled activities. It may feature various settings for alarm tones, snooze functions, and time displays, and is often powered by batteries or electricity. This device is distinct from other timekeeping devices by its primary function of providing alerts rather than simply displaying time or serving as a timer. Its design can range from traditional analog formats to modern digital interfaces, catering to diverse user preferences and needs.

---

## 27200109 — Analogous time switch

a device designed to control the timing of electrical circuits, this type of equipment functions by activating or deactivating a connected load based on predetermined time settings. Typically mechanical or electromechanical in nature, it operates without digital components and is utilized for various applications such as lighting control, heating systems, and other electrical devices that require time-dependent operation. The device can be programmed to turn on or off at specific intervals, allowing for efficient management of energy consumption and automation of tasks. Its design may incorporate dials or levers to set timing parameters, distinguishing it from other timekeeping instruments and digital counterparts.

---

## 27200110 — Digital time switch

a digital time switch refers to a device designed to control the timing of electrical circuits, enabling automated operation based on set time schedules. It typically features a digital display for easy programming and monitoring, allowing users to set specific on and off times for connected devices. This appliance is commonly used in various applications, including lighting control, irrigation systems, and HVAC systems, providing energy efficiency and convenience by automating the operation of electrical equipment. Unlike other timing devices, it is characterized by its digital interface and programmable capabilities, distinguishing it from traditional analog clocks and other timing mechanisms.

## 27200301 — Multimeter electrical Values

a device designed to measure and display various electrical parameters, including voltage, current, and resistance, enabling the analysis and troubleshooting of electrical circuits. This instrument typically features multiple measurement functions, allowing users to switch between different modes for enhanced versatility and convenience. Commonly utilized in both professional and educational settings, it serves as an essential tool for electricians, engineers, and technicians to ensure accurate readings and effective diagnostics in electrical systems. Its compact design often incorporates digital displays and may include additional functionalities such as data logging, continuity testing, and diode testing, making it a multifaceted instrument for electrical measurement tasks.

---

## 27200302 — Special measuring application (electrical variables)

a specialized measuring application designed for the evaluation and analysis of electrical variables, incorporating unique functionalities tailored for specific measurement tasks. This type of instrument is distinguished by its advanced capabilities to assess parameters such as voltage, current, resistance, and other electrical characteristics in various applications. It may include features that enable precise readings, data logging, and integration with other systems for enhanced performance in specialized environments. This classification encompasses tools that offer innovative methodologies for electrical measurement, ensuring accuracy and reliability in diverse scenarios beyond conventional measuring devices.

---

## 27200304 — Amperemeter

a device specifically designed to measure the electric current flowing through a conductor, providing quantitative data in various units, such as amperes. This instrument is essential for both diagnostic and operational purposes in electrical systems, allowing users to monitor and analyze current levels accurately. It is utilized in a range of applications, from residential electrical work to industrial settings, ensuring compliance with safety standards and facilitating troubleshooting. The design may vary, incorporating features like digital displays, analog readouts, and data logging capabilities, catering to different user requirements and operational environments. Its functionality is distinct from other measurement devices that focus on different electrical variables or specialized applications.

---

## 27200305 — Voltmeter

an instrument designed to measure the electrical potential difference between two points in an electric circuit. This device is crucial for assessing voltage levels and is commonly used in various applications, including electrical testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance. The instrument typically features a display that indicates the voltage value, enabling users to monitor and analyze electrical systems effectively. Its design may vary from analog to digital formats, catering to different user preferences and precision requirements. This measuring device is essential for ensuring the safe and efficient operation of electrical equipment and systems.

---

## 27200306 — Ohmmeter

Instrument for determining the electrical resistance of components or circuits, displayed in ohms.

---

## 27200307 — Wattmeter

a device specifically designed to measure electrical power in terms of watts, typically used to assess the energy consumption of electrical appliances and systems. This instrument quantifies the rate of energy transfer or conversion, providing essential data for energy management and efficiency analysis. Wattmeters can be utilized in various applications, including residential, commercial, and industrial settings, to monitor electrical usage and assist in optimizing energy consumption practices. They may feature analog or digital displays, offer real-time measurements, and can record data over time for further analysis.

---

## 27200308 — Voltage tester

a device designed to assess and measure electrical voltage levels in various circuits and systems. This instrument typically provides visual or audible indications of voltage presence and magnitude, allowing users to determine operational status and safety of electrical components. Voltage testers are essential tools in electrical diagnostics and maintenance, offering features such as non-contact detection, range selection, and often additional functionalities for enhanced versatility. They are widely utilized in both residential and industrial settings to ensure accurate voltage readings, contributing to effective troubleshooting and preventive measures in electrical systems.

---

## 27200309 — Oscilloscope

an oscilloscopic device is an electronic instrument used to visualize and analyze the waveform of electronic signals. It captures and displays voltage over time, allowing for the observation of signal characteristics such as amplitude, frequency, and waveform shape. This tool is essential in various fields, including engineering and telecommunications, for troubleshooting, design validation, and performance testing of electrical systems. The device typically features a screen for visual output, controls for adjusting time and voltage scales, and input channels for connecting to various signal sources. It is distinct from other measuring instruments by its ability to provide real-time graphical representation of dynamic signals, facilitating a deeper understanding of signal behavior in complex electronic circuits.

---

## 27200310 — Cyclic measuring application

this classification encompasses devices designed specifically for measuring cyclic electrical variables in various applications. These instruments are capable of capturing and analyzing waveforms that exhibit periodic behavior, aiding in the assessment of electrical performance and characteristics. The tools included in this classification are utilized in diverse fields such as engineering, telecommunications, and energy management, providing insights into the behavior of electrical systems under cyclic conditions. The functionality of these devices enables users to monitor, diagnose, and optimize electrical circuits, ensuring efficiency and safety in operations.

---

## 27200311 — Capacitance meter

## 27210901 — Voltage transformer

a device specifically designed to step down high voltage levels to lower, manageable levels for measurement or control purposes. This type of transformer facilitates the safe and accurate monitoring of electrical systems by converting high voltage signals into proportional lower voltage signals. Typically utilized in power distribution networks, its primary function is to isolate the measuring instruments from high voltage lines while ensuring that the voltage can be effectively measured or displayed. This category is distinct from other transformer types, which serve different roles such as current measurement, pulse isolation, or frequency conversion.

---

## 27210902 — Current transformer

a device that is designed to measure alternating current (AC) by producing a proportional output current, typically used for metering and protection purposes in electrical systems. This apparatus functions by transforming high primary current values to lower, manageable secondary current levels, allowing for accurate monitoring and control of electrical parameters. It is essential in ensuring safety and efficiency in power distribution networks, distinguishing itself from other types of transformers that focus on voltage or frequency transformation.

---

## 27210903 — PI/IP transformer

a device designed to convert electrical signals from one form to another, specifically for the purpose of processing and transforming power in electrical networks. It is utilized in various applications where precise signal manipulation is essential, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. This device operates under specified parameters to maintain efficiency and safety in electrical installations, distinguishing it from other types of transformers that focus solely on voltage, current, or frequency adjustments.

## 27210904 — Frequency transformer

a device designed to convert electrical energy from one frequency to another while altering its voltage characteristics. Frequency transformers are utilized in various industrial, commercial, and residential settings, providing critical support for systems that require specific frequency outputs for optimal performance. These transformers are distinct from other types that primarily focus on adjusting voltage or current levels without frequency modification.

## 27211001 — System monitor

a system monitor is a device or software tool designed to oversee and evaluate the operational status and performance of various machinery or processes. It collects, analyzes, and presents data regarding the functioning of equipment, ensuring that all systems operate within specified parameters. The system monitor plays a crucial role in identifying abnormalities, facilitating preventive maintenance, and enhancing operational efficiency by providing real-time insights into performance metrics. It is essential for ensuring reliability and safety in industrial environments, enabling timely responses to potential issues and contributing to overall system optimization.

## 27211002 — Vibration monitor

a device designed to detect and measure vibrations within machinery, providing real-time data to assess operational performance and potential mechanical issues. This tool helps in monitoring the condition of equipment by analyzing vibration patterns, enabling proactive maintenance and minimizing the risk of failure. It plays a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and longevity of rotating machinery by alerting users to abnormal vibration levels that may indicate wear or misalignment. The information gathered can be utilized for diagnostic purposes, enhancing overall system efficiency and safety.

## 27211003 — Position monitor

This device is essential for ensuring the proper functioning of machinery, as it helps prevent misalignment, mechanical failure, and safety hazards. Position monitors typically incorporate sensors and advanced processing algorithms to deliver accurate positioning information, which can be integrated into broader automation systems for enhanced operational control and performance optimization.

It typically features sensors that detect temperature variations, user interfaces for data visualization, and connectivity options for integration with control systems or monitoring networks. The primary function is to enhance safety and efficiency by enabling timely responses to temperature fluctuations, contributing to the overall reliability of the monitored systems.

## 27260202 — Capacitor, ceramic

a component designed to store electrical energy in an electric field, typically constructed from ceramic materials. This type of component is characterized by its ability to maintain a stable capacitance value across a wide range of temperatures and voltages. It is commonly used in various electronic applications, including filtering, coupling, and decoupling circuits. The construction typically involves layers of ceramic dielectric material, which provides a reliable performance in both consumer and industrial electronic devices. This component is distinct from other capacitor types by its specific material properties and performance characteristics, making it suitable for applications that require durability and high reliability.

---

## 27260205 — Capacitor, film

a component designed to store and release electrical energy in an electronic circuit, characterized by a dielectric material made from a thin film of plastic. These components are used in various applications, including signal coupling, filtering, and timing circuits, and are known for their stability and reliability. Their construction allows for precise capacitance values and low losses, making them suitable for high-frequency applications. Distinct from other types of capacitors, this specific type utilizes a film dielectric, differentiating it from other capacitor types that employ different materials or construction methods.

---

## 27260206 — Fixed electrolytic capacitor

a fixed electrolytic capacitor is an electronic component that stores electrical energy in an electric field, characterized by its ability to provide large capacitance values in a compact form. This type of capacitor consists of two conductive plates separated by an electrolyte, which allows for a higher charge storage capacity compared to other capacitor types. Fixed electrolytic capacitors are polarized, meaning they have a positive and negative terminal, and must be connected correctly within a circuit to function properly. They are widely used in power supply applications, audio equipment, and various electronic devices where stable capacitance is required. The distinguishing feature of this type lies in its construction and specific performance characteristics, setting it apart from other capacitor types that utilize different materials or designs.

---

## 27260207 — Fixed doublelayer capacitor

a fixed double-layer capacitor is an electronic component that stores electrical energy in an electric field, utilizing the electrostatic charge accumulation between two conductive plates separated by a dielectric medium. This type of capacitor features a double-layer structure, which enhances its capacitance and energy storage capabilities compared to traditional capacitors. It is characterized by its ability to maintain a constant capacitance value under a variety of operating conditions, making it suitable for applications requiring stability and reliability. Commonly used in circuits for energy storage, filtering, and signal coupling, this component plays a crucial role in enhancing the performance of electronic devices.

---

## 27260208 — Fixed mica capacitor

a type of electrical component designed to store electrical energy in an electric field. This component is characterized by its use of mica as the dielectric material, which provides excellent stability and low loss characteristics. It is typically used in applications requiring high reliability and precision, such as in oscillators, filters, and timing circuits. These components are non-polarized and are known for their durability and ability to operate over a wide range of temperatures and frequencies. The fixed nature of this capacitor means that its capacitance value cannot be adjusted after manufacturing, distinguishing it from other types that may allow for variable capacitance adjustments.

---

## 27260209 — Variable tuning Capacitor

a variable tuning capacitor is an electronic component designed to adjust its capacitance value dynamically, allowing for fine-tuning of circuits, particularly in radio frequency applications. This component typically consists of movable plates that change the effective area of the capacitor, thus altering its capacitance. It is commonly used in tuning circuits, oscillators, and filters, where precise capacitance adjustments are essential for optimal performance. Unlike other capacitor types, which have fixed capacitance values or specific materials, the variable tuning capacitor provides flexibility in electrical characteristics, making it suitable for applications requiring variable frequency response and signal quality enhancement.

---

## 27260210 — Variable trimmer capacitor

a variable trimmer capacitor is a type of electrical component designed to store electrical energy in an electric field, with the ability to adjust its capacitance value. This adjustment allows for fine-tuning of electronic circuits, enabling precise control over frequency response and signal quality. Typically small in size, these capacitors are used in applications where space is limited and where minor changes in capacitance can significantly influence circuit performance. Unlike fixed capacitors, which maintain a constant capacitance, variable trimmer capacitors provide flexibility for calibration and optimization in various electronic devices. They are commonly employed in tuning circuits, oscillators, and other applications requiring precise capacitance adjustments.

---

## 27260211 — Variable pre-set capacitor

a variable pre-set capacitor is an electronic component designed to store electrical energy in an electric field, characterized by its ability to have capacitance adjusted within a specified range. This type of capacitor allows for fine-tuning of capacitance values, enabling precise control in various applications. It is typically used in circuits that require variable capacitance for tuning and adjustment purposes, such as in radio frequency applications, oscillators, and filters. The design and functionality of a variable pre-set capacitor distinguish it from other capacitor types, which may have fixed capacitance values or different dielectric materials, thereby fulfilling specific electronic needs in a diverse range of devices.

---

## 27261301 — Diode (discrete component)

a diode is a semiconductor device that allows current to flow in one direction while blocking it in the opposite direction. It serves as a fundamental building block in electronic circuits, utilized for various functions such as rectification, signal modulation, and voltage regulation. Diodes are characterized by their specific electrical properties and are available in different types, each designed for particular applications, including standard, Zener, Schottky, and light-emitting diodes. The classification of diodes distinguishes them from other discrete components, such as transistors, thyristors, and triacs, which have different operational principles and applications within electronic systems.

---

## 27261302 — Transistor (discrete component)

a discrete electronic component that is capable of amplifying or switching electronic signals and electrical power. This component typically has three or more terminals for connection to an external circuit and operates based on the principle of controlling the flow of current. Transistors are fundamental building blocks in modern electronic devices, allowing for various functions such as signal modulation, amplification, and digital logic operations. They can be made from various semiconductor materials and come in different types, each suited for specific applications within electronic systems.

---

## 27261303 — Thyristor (discrete component)

a thyristor is a type of semiconductor device that acts as a switch, controlling the flow of electric current in a circuit. It is composed of four layers of alternating n- and p-type materials, forming three junctions. Thyristors are designed to handle high voltage and current, making them suitable for applications in power electronics. They are commonly used in circuits for controlling alternating current, offering advantages such as low on-state voltage drop and high efficiency. Their ability to remain in the on state after being triggered makes them ideal for various applications including motor control, light dimming, and overvoltage protection. This category specifically distinguishes thyristors from other discrete components like diodes, transistors, and triacs, which have different operational principles and applications.

---

## 27261304 — Triac

a triac is a type of semiconductor device that can control current flow in both directions. It is primarily used for switching and controlling alternating current (AC) loads. This device is characterized by its ability to conduct current when triggered and to stop conducting when the current falls below a certain threshold. Triacs are commonly utilized in applications such as light dimmers, motor speed controls, and temperature control systems. Their versatile operation allows for efficient management of electrical devices, making them essential components in various electronic circuits and systems. ## 27261501 — Light emitting diode (opto-component)

a light emitting diode is a semiconductor device that emits light when an electric current passes through it. This opto-component operates based on the principle of electroluminescence, where electrons recombine with electron holes within the device, releasing energy in the form of photons. Light emitting diodes are widely used in various applications, including indicators, displays, and lighting solutions, due to their efficiency and longevity. They are distinct from other opto-components such as infrared components, optocouplers, and light photosensors, which serve different functions and operate using different principles of light interaction and detection. The versatility and energy efficiency of light emitting diodes make them an essential component in modern electronic and lighting technologies.

---

## 27261502 — Infrared component

a specialized electronic device that operates by emitting or detecting infrared radiation. This component is commonly used in various applications such as remote controls, motion sensors, and thermal imaging systems. Infrared components are designed to facilitate communication or measurement by utilizing infrared light, which is invisible to the human eye. They can vary in functionality, including but not limited to the transmission of data, sensing environmental changes, or providing illumination in the infrared spectrum. These components are integral to enhancing the performance and capabilities of many electronic systems, particularly in automation, security, and consumer electronics.

---

## 27261503 — Optocoupler

a component designed to transmit electrical signals while providing electrical isolation between its input and output circuits. This device utilizes light to achieve signal transfer, effectively allowing for the control of high-voltage circuits by low-voltage signals. Typically consisting of a light-emitting diode paired with a photodetector, this technology is essential in applications where signal integrity and safety from voltage spikes are paramount. It is commonly used in various electronic devices for signal processing, control systems, and communication interfaces, ensuring reliable operation in diverse environments.

---

## 27261504 — Infrared light photosensor

a device designed to detect infrared light and convert it into an electrical signal, facilitating the measurement or control of infrared radiation. This technology is commonly utilized in various applications, including automation, safety systems, and environmental monitoring. The photosensor operates by sensing the intensity or presence of infrared light, enabling functionalities such as proximity detection, motion sensing, and data transmission in infrared communications. This category encompasses devices that are distinct from other opto-components by focusing specifically on infrared light detection, distinguishing them from those that emit light or operate in different spectral ranges.

---

## 27261505 — Ultraviolet light photosensor

a device designed to detect and measure ultraviolet light, typically converting UV radiation into an electronic signal. These sensors are commonly used in various applications, including environmental monitoring, safety systems, and industrial processes, where UV exposure needs to be quantified. They play a crucial role in ensuring safety standards in environments where ultraviolet radiation is present, allowing for the effective monitoring and control of UV levels. The technology employed in these sensors may vary, incorporating advanced materials and designs to enhance sensitivity and accuracy in detecting UV light across different wavelengths.

## 27261602 — Gate driver

a gate driver is an electronic component designed to control the operation of power devices, such as transistors or thyristors, by providing the necessary voltage and current to turn them on and off efficiently. It ensures that the switching characteristics of these devices are optimized for performance, enabling fast and reliable operation in various applications, including power supplies, motor drives, and inverters. Gate drivers are essential in managing the high-speed switching requirements and can be integrated into circuits to enhance system performance by reducing switching losses and improving electromagnetic compatibility. Their design often incorporates features such as isolation, protection, and level shifting to accommodate different voltage levels in the control signals.

---

## 27261603 — Active filter (Analogue component)

a type of electronic component designed to selectively allow certain frequencies to pass while attenuating others. This device is characterized by its ability to modify signals in analog circuits, enhancing specific signal components while suppressing unwanted noise or interference. Active filters typically utilize amplifying elements to provide gain, thereby enabling them to maintain signal integrity across a range of operating conditions. These components are essential in applications requiring signal conditioning, audio processing, and frequency response shaping, contributing to improved overall system performance and efficiency.

---

## 27261604 — Interface (Analogue component)

a category that encompasses devices designed to facilitate the transfer of analog signals between different systems or components. These devices typically ensure that the analog signals maintain their integrity while transitioning from one interface to another. This classification includes various types of interfaces that operate with continuous signal variations, enabling smooth communication and interaction within electronic systems. The focus is on components that perform functions such as signal conditioning, buffering, or conversion, ensuring that the analog signals can be effectively utilized in different applications across various electronic and electrical systems.

---

## 27261605 — Tuner (Analogue component)

a device designed to receive and process analog signals for the purpose of selecting and tuning into specific frequencies. This component typically operates by adjusting its internal settings to match the desired signal, thereby enhancing the clarity and quality of the output. It is primarily utilized in various electronic applications where the accurate reception of analog signals is crucial. The device may include features for signal amplification, filtering, and demodulation, ensuring optimal performance in a wide range of settings.

---

## 27261606 — Operational amplifier (Analogue component)

an operational amplifier is a versatile electronic device that amplifies voltage signals with high gain and high input impedance. It is typically designed for linear applications where continuous signal processing is required. This component is characterized by its ability to perform various mathematical operations such as addition, subtraction, integration, and differentiation, making it essential in analog circuits. Its features often include differential inputs, a single-ended output, and the capability to operate with both AC and DC signals. Operational amplifiers are widely used in signal conditioning, filtering, and feedback systems, playing a crucial role in a broad array of applications within electronic devices.

---

## 27261608 — Supervisory IC (Analogue component)

a category consisting of electronic components designed to monitor and control processes by providing feedback and management functions within various systems. These components are typically characterized by their ability to handle analog signals and facilitate communication between different elements of a circuit or system. They serve crucial roles in ensuring the stability and performance of devices by regulating and supervising operations, enabling efficient functionality in diverse applications. This classification is distinct from similar components that focus on signal processing, driving mechanisms, or interfacing tasks, highlighting its specific role in oversight and control within electronic environments.

---

## 27261610 — Voltage comparator (Analogue component)

a device designed to compare two voltage levels and provide an output signal indicating which of the two levels is higher. This component is typically used in various electronic circuits to ensure that voltage thresholds are met, enabling precise control in applications such as signal processing, feedback systems, and voltage regulation. Its functionality is essential in maintaining the integrity of electronic systems by providing accurate voltage comparisons, thereby facilitating the proper operation of other connected components. This type of device plays a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and efficiency of electronic designs.

---

## 27261611 — Voltage reference

a voltage reference is a specialized electronic component that provides a stable and precise voltage output over time and varying conditions. It is designed to serve as a reference point for other electronic circuits, ensuring consistent operation and accuracy in voltage measurements and applications. Voltage references are crucial in analog circuits where precision is essential, such as in analog-to-digital converters, operational amplifiers, and other devices that require reliable and fixed voltage levels for optimal performance. These components can be integrated or discrete and may offer various output voltage levels, temperature coefficients, and package types to suit different application needs.

Unlike other processing units that may handle broader or more complex computing tasks, microcontrollers are optimized for efficiency, low power consumption, and real-time control within defined applications. ## 27270501 — Incremental encoder

Sensor for generating information about the speed and position of rotational movements. The sensor emits pulses which are interpreted as speed or position information by a control. A reference run can be necessary when switching on the machine

---

## 27270502 — Absolute encoder

Sensor for generating information about the position and speed (optional) of rotational movements. Each position is assigned a unique reference on the measuring element. There is therefore no need for a reference run after switching on. A singleturn absolute encoder measures the absolute position within a revolution. A multiturn absolute encoder measures the absolute position over several revolutions

---

## 27270503 — Wire-actuated encoder

Position sensor that functions according to the cable extension principle. A sensor system consisting of a wire draw mechanism and a rotary encoder. The core component of a wire draw encoder is a drum around which a wire is wound in a single layer. Winding is achieved by means of a spring. The resolution of the wire draw encoder can be determined from the relationship between the circumference of the drum and the resolution of the rotary encoder

---

## 27270504 — Measuring wheel encoder

Measuring system which uses a measuring wheel and direct contact with the measuring surface to record linear movements on various surfaces and converts these movements into speed or position values

---
