## 27270901 — One-way light barrier

In a through-beam photoelectric sensor, sender and receiver are accommodated in separate housings and are installed opposite one another. If an object interrupts the direct path between sender and receiver, this change is registered by the receive diode and output as a switching signal via an electronics unit. A through-beam photoelectric sensor can bridge long distances (up to 50 m) and, in principle, can detect any non-transparent object

---

## 27270902 — Reflection light barrier

With a photoelectric retro-reflective sensor, the light emitted by the light sender is returned by a reflector and is received and evaluated by the receiver installed in the device. Photoelectric retro-reflective sensors are available with autocollimation or dual lenses

---

## 27270903 — Light scanner

Photoelectric proximity switches are based on the geometrical relationship between transmitting and receiving elements. The button is set to the object lying in the button plane

---

## 27270905 — Fiber optic amplifier

Fiber optic amplifier has a light source and a receiver to which fiber optics are connected. The electronics evaluate the received light signal and switch one or more outputs or pass this as an electrical signal to a controller

---

## 27270906 — Contrast scanner

Contrast sensors are primarily used in packaging/printing machines for the detection of printed or control marks. Contrast sensors detects even the smallest contrasts at the highest speeds, such as print marks on foils or packaging. They detect minute grayscale variations between the mark and the background on matte, shiny or transparent surfaces. A variety of device types with different contrast resolution methods and teach-in versions are available to meet wide-ranging requirements

---

## 27270907 — Color sensor

Color sensors detect the color of a surface. The sensors cast light (red, green, and blue LEDs) on the objects to be tested, calculate the chromaticity coordinates from the reflected radiation and compare them with previously stored reference colors. If the color values are within the set tolerance range, a switching output is activated

---

## 27270908 — Luminescence scanner

Luminescence sensors detect visible and non-visible marks that illuminate when using ultraviolet (UV) light. Fluorescent material and marks are reliably detected independently of their pattern, colors or surface conditions on any material. Luminescence sensors emit UV light with a wave length of approximately 375 nm. Fluorescent substances convert the UV light into long-wave visible light, which is then received and evaluated by the luminescence sensor

---

## 27270909 — Fork sensor

Fork sensors combine senders and receivers in a single housing, meaning that they can be adjusted quickly. Thanks to the precise, focused light beam and the high detection accuracy, the sensors also detect very minor light attentuation differences. Many different fork sizes, straightforward mounting, and exceptionally high ambient light immunity are just some of the advantages of these fork sensors

---

## 27270910 — Light curtain

Light curtains/ Light grids are switching or measuring sensors, consisting of several regularly spaced parallel photoelectric sensors. When an object interrupts only a single beam of the light grid, this is detected by the sensor and triggers a switching operation. In principle, only objects can be reliably detected that are greater than the distance of two beams

---

## 27270911 — Optical frame

Frame light barrier is an optical sensor used to detect the passage or interruption of a light beam in a defined area. It consists of one or more transmitters that generate light beams and one or more receivers that detect interrupted light beams. The frame light barrier is often used to detect objects in a specific area. By using a rectangular frame, it enables reliable detection without adjustment across an area. When an object passes through the frame and interrupts the light beam, this is detected as a signal

---

## 27270913 — Laser scanner

Laser scanner is an optical measuring device used to capture and measure three-dimensional objects or environments. The laser scanner emits a laser beam and measures the time it takes for the beam to reach the object and return reflected. The distance to the various points on the surface is calculated based on the beam's travel time. The continuous rotation or swivel movement of the laser scanner can achieve complete 360-degree coverage of the environment.

---

## 27270915 — Multi-beam light barrier

Multi-beam light barriers are active optoelectronic protective devices (AOPDs) that use transmitting and receiving elements to detect people in a given two-dimensional area. A series of parallel light beams that are sent from the transmitter to the receiver create a protective field that secures the danger area. Detection occurs when one or more beams are completely interrupted by an opaque object. The receiver signals the beam interruption by changing the signal (OFF state) at its switching outputs (OSSDs). The signals from the OSSDs are used to stop the dangerous machine state. Safety-related multi-beam light barriers have a detection capacity of more than 40 mm and are used to secure access to danger areas.

---

## 27270916 — Optical distance sensor

Electromechanical rear derailleur consists of a series of components such as levers, cams, gears or switches that are connected to each other and work in a specific order. Through the movement and interaction of these components, certain actions or switching states can be achieved. A derailleur is used to realize simple operations or controls by performing various steps or circuits in a predetermined sequence

---

## 27270917 — Multiple layer checking sensor

Multi-layer control sensors are used to count products (e.g. printed copies) that are transported in layers on conveyor belts or conveyor lines (shingled flow)

---

## 27270918 — Optical displacement sensor

Optical displacement sensors are based on an optoelectronic sensor reading codes on a metal or plastic code rail or code tape. The reading method provides absolute values and works contactless

---

## 27270919 — Optical level switch

Wave level switch that uses an optical means to detect a level regime

---

## 27270924 — Glare sensor

Glare sensor detects and distinguishes glare on even surfaces – regardless of color, transparency or pattern

---

## 27270925 — Pattern sensor

Pattern sensor is a proximity-scanning opto-electronic sensor. Distinctive patterns in an image are used as a reference for the subsequent, accurate detection and positioning of objects. A stable switching signal is generated at high speeds with an intelligent algorithm for signal processing regardless of reference marks. It is typically used in the packaging industry

---

## 27270926 — Array sensor

Array sensors operate on the proximity scanning principle. They detect even the smallest edges based on differences in grayscale values within the field-of-view. Positioning of, for example, a paper web based on the web edge or a contrast line is only one of many possible applications. Widths, diameters, and gaps can also be detected. In reflector mode, the array sensors can even detect transparent materials

---

## 27272501 — Incremental safety encoder

Functional safety sensor for generating information about the speed and position of rotational movements. The sensor emits pulses which are interpreted as speed or position information by a control. The position is not uniquely assigned on the measuring element. A reference run can be necessary when switching on the machine. Intended for use in safety applications

---

## 27272502 — Absolute safety encoder

Functional safety sensor for generating information about the position and speed of rotational movements. Each position is assigned a unique reference on the measuring element. There is therefore no need for a reference run after switching on. A singleturn absolute encoder measures the absolute position within a revolution. A multiturn absolute encoder measures the absolute position over several revolutions. Intended for use in safety applications

## 27272701 — Safety-related irradiating light barrier

Safety-related irradiating light barriers are active opto-electronic protective devices (AOPDs). They comprise self-testing senders and receivers or testable senders and receivers combined with an evaluation unit. If the light beam is interrupted the receiver signals the beam interruption by a signal change (OFF state) to its output signal switching devices (OSSDs). The signals of the OSSDs are used to stop the hazardous machine functions

---

## 27272702 — Safety-related reflection light barrier

Safety position switches type 1 are uncoded, cam-operated position switches in which the actuator and actuation system are separate, but structurally designed to match each other. These comply with the standards for machine safety

---

## 27272703 — Safety-related multiple beam light barrier

Safety-related multiple beam light barriers are active opto-electronic protective devices that use emitting and receiving elements to detect persons in a defined two-dimensional area. A series of parallel light beams transmitted from the sender to the receiver form a protective field that safeguards the hazardous area. Detection occurs when an opaque object fully interrupts one or more beams. The receiver signals the beam interruption by a signal change (OFF state) to its output signal switching devices (OSSDs). The signals of the OSSDs are used to stop the hazardous machine functions. Safety-related multiple beam light barrier are the AOPDs with a detection capability of more than 40 mm. They are used to protect access to hazardous areas

---

## 27272704 — Safety-related light curtain

Safety-related light curtains are active opto-electronic protective devices that use emitting and receiving elements to detect persons in a defined two-dimensional area. A series of parallel light beams transmitted from the sender to the receiver form a protective field that safeguards the hazardous area. Detection occurs when an opaque object fully interrupts one or more beams. The receiver signals the beam interruption by a signal change (OFF state) to its output signal switching devices (OSSDs). The signals of the OSSDs are used to stop the hazardous machine functions. Safety-related light curtains - a detection capability of 40 mm or less and are used to protect hazardous points directly

---

## 27272705 — Safety-related laser scanner

Safety-related laser scanner is an optical measuring device that is used to secure danger areas and access. The safety-related laser scanner sends out a laser beam and measures the time it takes for the beam to reach the object and return reflected. The distance to the various points on the surface is calculated based on the travel time of the beam. Through the continuous rotation or panning movement of the laser scanner, a complete 360 degree coverage of the environment can be achieved. The safety-related laser scanners comply with the standards for machine safety

---

## 27272707 — Safety-related multibeam scanner

Safety-related multi-beam scanner is a contactless protective device (ESPE) that combines the advantages of a safety light curtain with those of a safety laser scanner. Thanks to the secure solid-state technology of the LiDAR sensors, transmitter and receiver units are compactly integrated in one device without moving parts

## 27272803 — Ultrasonic proximity switch

a device designed to detect the presence or proximity of an object using ultrasonic waves, functioning by emitting sound pulses and measuring the time taken for the echoes to return. This type of sensor is specifically engineered to provide reliable, non-contact detection and is commonly used in automation and control applications. Unlike other ultrasonic sensing technologies, this device typically operates by sensing changes in the return signal caused by objects within its detection range, making it ideal for applications requiring precise distance measurement without the need for physical contact. Its design allows for versatility in various environments, ensuring accurate and efficient performance in diverse industrial and commercial settings.

---

## 27274801 — Thermal flow sensor

Thermal flow sensors (also known as calorimetric flow sensors) use the specific ability of a liquid or gaseous medium to transport a quantity of heat. Since the mass of the passing medium is essential for the removal of the heat quantity provided by a heating element, thermal sensors are also known as mass flow sensors. If the medium is known, the heat quantity transport depends only on the flow velocity, which is usually measured using the heat loss method or the heat transfer method. In the heat loss method, the temperature difference between a heater and a temperature sensor, both of which are usually designed as electrical resistors, is kept constant by the electrical regulation in a bridge circuit. The electrical power required to adjust the bridge to a constant temperature difference between the heater and the temperature sensor is a measure of the amount of heat lost by a flowing fluid and is therefore directly related to the flow velocity

---

## 27274802 — Magnetic inductive flow sensor

Magnetic-inductive flow sensors, or MID for short, use a measuring method based on the law of electromagnetic induction. Coils arranged perpendicular to the direction of flow generate a magnetic field. A conductive fluid passing through the magnetic field induces a current between two electrodes, which can be used to measure a voltage.The induced voltage is proportional to the flow velocity

---

## 27274803 — Ultrasonic flow sensor

Ultrasonic flowmeters, or USD or UDM for short, measure the flow velocity of a liquid or gaseous medium using acoustic waves

---

## 27274804 — Vortex flow sensor

Vortex flow sensors use the measuring principle of Karman's vortex street. Here, counter-rotating vortices form behind a flowing body, which lead to local pressure differences that can be detected by suitable measuring elements. The vortex frequency determined in this way is linearly related to the volume flow via a proportionality constant

---

## 27274805 — Pitot and differential pressure based flow sensor

Pitot and differential pressure based flow sensors use orifice and nozzle geometries in the flow channel to be able to detect the pitot or differential pressure, which depends on the flow velocity, with suitable pressure sensors

---

## 27274806 — Mechanical flow sensor

Mechanical flow sensors usually use a rotating mechanical element to measure the flow velocity. The rotational speed of an impeller, turbine or gear wheel, for example, can be measured with a suitable measuring element and is directly related to the flow velocity and thus, with a known pipe cross-section, to the volume flow of the medium

---

device that measures the flow rate of air in a system

## 27274808 — Flow switch, liquid

switch that detects and controls the flow of liquid in a system

## 27274901 — Piezoresistive pressure sensor

Piezoresistive sensors are semiconductors made of silicon that change their resistivity due to the application of a force. The semiconductor chip consists of a membrane structured with piezoresistive resistors that bends under pressure. Typically, four strain gages are integrated into the silicon membrane and connected to form the Wheatstone measuring bridge. Piezoresistive pressure sensors can be constructed as absolute pressure, relative pressure and differential pressure sensors

---

## 27274902 — Ceramic - thick film - pressure sensor

Ceramic thick-film sensors consist of aluminum oxide. Their base body is designed as a solid ring whose front side forms a membrane. On the side facing away from the pressure, strain gauges are applied by means of screen printing and burned in. The resistivity change of the metallic strain gauges under the influence of pressure on the membrane can be interconnected and measured in a Wheatstone's measuring bridge. Ceramic thick film sensors can be constructed as absolute pressure and relative pressure sensors

---

## 27274903 — Metal - thin film - pressure sensor

Metal thin-film sensors consist of a circular ring membrane made of stainless steel. The conductor material for the strain gauges is applied to the diaphragm by vapor deposition and the structures are then photo-etched. The resistivity change of the metal strain gauges under the influence of pressure on the membrane can be measured in a Wheatstone bridge. Metal thin-film sensors are designed as relative pressure sensors

---

## 27274904 — Mechanical pressure sensor

Mechanical pressure switches are actuated by pressure changes of a gaseous or liquid medium. The most common principle is based on a membrane in combination with a spring. A pressure change expands the membrane and opens or closes an electrical switching contact. The spring can be used to set the switching and reverse switching point

---

## 27274905 — Pressure transmitter

sensing device or sensor used in various industrial and process control applications to measure and transmit information about the pressure of a fluid (liquid or gas). It typically converts the applied pressure into an analogue electrical signal, such as a voltage or current, which is then transmitted to a control system, data logger, or operator interface. They provide real-time data that can be used for process control, safety, and maintenance purposes

## 27275001 — Pneumatic proximity switch

Pneumatic proximity switch is a sensor which, when an object approaches a nozzle, from which compressed air exits, is able to detect this object without contact using the dynamic pressure principle The change in dynamic pressure can be used directly as a control signal for a valve, for example, or it can be converted into an electrical signal by detecting the status variables pressure, differential pressure (with the integration of an orifice) or volume flow. A binary signal, object detected/not detected, is provided

---

## 27275002 — Pneumatic distance sensor

Pneumatic distance sensor is a sensor which, when an object approaches a nozzle, from which compressed air exits, recognises this object without contact using the dynamic pressure principle and can assign a distance-correlated value. By using look-up tables, it is possible to detect a distance value in relation to the nozzle. An analogue signal is provided, which is in correlation to the distance of the nozzle

---

## 27275003 — Pneumatic fork barrier

With the pneumatic fork barrier, the interruption of an air jet between the transmitter and receiver nozzle by the object to be scanned causes a signal pressure drop in the receiver nozzle. The change in signal pressure can either be used directly as a control signal for a valve, for example, or converted into an electrical signal by detecting the state variables pressure

---

## 27275004 — Pneumatic one-way barrier

With the pneumatic throughbeam barrier, the reflection of an air jet at the object to be scanned leads to a signal pressure build-up in the control connection depending on the sensing distance and supply pressure. The change in signal pressure can either be used directly as a control signal for a valve, for example, or converted into an electrical signal by detecting the state variables pressure

---

## 27280601 — Chip card

a chip card is a type of card that incorporates an embedded microchip, allowing for secure data storage and processing. It is commonly used in various applications such as identification, access control, and payment systems. The microchip enables enhanced security features, including encryption and authentication processes, which help protect sensitive information and prevent unauthorized access. Unlike other identification methods that may combine different technologies, this card operates solely on the principles of chip-based technology, distinguishing it from systems that utilize both chip and magnetic elements or those designed specifically for maintenance purposes. Chip cards are widely adopted in industries requiring secure transactions and reliable identification methods.

---

## 27280602 — Hybrid systems (chip card and magnetic)

a collection of systems that integrate both chip card technology and magnetic stripe functionality, allowing for versatile identification and access control solutions. These systems are designed to operate using both methods of data storage and retrieval, providing enhanced security and user convenience. They are commonly utilized in various applications, including but not limited to access management, payment processing, and secure identification. This classification distinguishes these hybrid systems from those that rely solely on chip card technology or magnetic strip technology, highlighting their unique combination of features and capabilities.

---

## 27280603 — Cleaning card

a cleaning card is a specialized tool designed for the maintenance and enhancement of electronic identification systems. It typically features a surface that can effectively remove dirt, dust, and contaminants from the reading surfaces of electromechanical devices. By ensuring optimal cleanliness, the cleaning card helps to maintain the performance and reliability of identification systems. This type of card is distinct from other identification methods, such as those employing integrated circuits or magnetic strips, as it focuses specifically on physical maintenance rather than data storage or transmission. The cleaning card is essential in environments where frequent use of identification devices may lead to residue accumulation, ensuring seamless operation and longevity of the equipment.

---

## 27320101 — Platform scale

a platform scale is a type of weighing instrument designed for measuring the weight of larger or bulk items. It typically features a flat surface that provides stable support for items during weighing. These scales are commonly used in industrial and commercial settings where heavy loads need to be weighed with accuracy and efficiency. The platform scale can accommodate various capacities and sizes, making it versatile for different applications, from inventory management to shipping and receiving. Its design allows for easy loading and unloading of goods, enhancing operational productivity. Platform scales are often equipped with digital displays for user-friendly reading and can be integrated with other systems for data management and analysis.

---

## 27320102 — Platform scale

a platform scale is a type of weighing device characterized by a flat, horizontal platform designed to hold items for measurement. It typically employs load cells or similar mechanisms to accurately determine the weight of objects placed on it. This equipment is commonly utilized in various industrial and commercial settings for tasks that require the precise weighing of goods and materials, allowing for efficient inventory management, shipping, and processing operations. The platform scale is distinguished from other weighing systems by its specific design and functionality, which cater to the needs of users requiring reliable and straightforward weight measurement for items of varying sizes and weights.

---

## 27320103 — Road weighbridge (truck scale)

a weighbridge is a large scale used to measure the weight of heavy vehicles, such as trucks, as they drive onto the platform. Typically installed in industrial settings, these systems provide accurate weight measurements for compliance with regulations, logistical planning, and resource management. They are designed to handle substantial loads and often feature digital displays for easy readability. Weighbridges play a crucial role in transportation and logistics by ensuring that vehicles are not overloaded, thus promoting safety and efficiency in operations. The technology may include various components such as load cells, indicators, and software for data processing, and can be integrated with other systems for automated operations.

---

## 27320104 — Rail weighing system (rail-weighbridge)

a rail weighing system is an apparatus designed for the precise measurement of the weight of rail vehicles as they pass over it. This system typically consists of a series of load cells installed within a track structure that accurately captures the weight of trains, cars, or other rail-bound transport. The technology is essential for various applications including compliance with transportation regulations, load management, and operational efficiency in logistics and freight handling. Unlike other weighing technologies, this system is specifically tailored for rail transport, ensuring accurate readings even in dynamic conditions, and plays a crucial role in the automation and optimization of rail operations.

---

## 27320105 — Unit count scale

a measurement system designed to quantify and display the number of individual units contained within a defined space or batch. This system is typically employed in various industrial applications where precise counting of items is essential for inventory management, quality control, and production efficiency. It utilizes advanced technology to ensure accurate and reliable unit counts, accommodating a wide range of product types and sizes. The purpose of this measurement system is to enhance operational efficiency by providing quick and accurate counting capabilities, thereby facilitating better resource allocation and inventory tracking in industrial environments.

---

## 27320106 — Crane scale (overhead track scale)

a type of weighing device specifically designed for measuring the weight of objects suspended from an overhead track system. These devices utilize a mechanism that incorporates a load cell to produce accurate weight measurements, typically in industrial environments. They are engineered for overhead applications, allowing for the efficient handling of heavy loads while ensuring precise weight readings. ## 27371501 — Thermal overload relay

a thermal overload relay is a protective device designed to safeguard electrical motors and equipment from overheating caused by excessive current. It operates by detecting changes in temperature, typically through a bimetallic element or similar mechanism, which reacts to increased thermal conditions resulting from overload situations. When the temperature exceeds a predefined threshold, the relay interrupts the electrical circuit, thereby preventing damage to the motor or connected equipment. This type of relay is distinct from other protective devices, such as electronic overload relays or relays specifically designed for thermistor protection, as it relies on thermal effects rather than electronic sensing or thermistor input for operation.

---

## 27371502 — Electronic overload relay

an electronic overload relay is a protective device designed to monitor electrical currents and prevent overheating in circuits by disconnecting the power supply when excessive current is detected. Unlike other overload protection devices, this type utilizes electronic components to provide precise monitoring and faster response times. It is typically adjustable, allowing for customizable settings to suit specific applications. This relay offers advanced features such as phase failure detection and fault indication, enhancing equipment protection and operational efficiency. Its application spans various industries where electrical machinery and equipment require reliable overload protection to ensure safe and efficient operation.

The equipment is essential in various applications where safety and reliability in electrical installations are paramount, serving as a key component in low-voltage switch technology monitoring systems.

---

## 27371810 — Temperature monitoring equipment

this category encompasses devices designed to measure and track temperature variations in various environments. These instruments provide critical data for monitoring thermal conditions to ensure safety, efficiency, and optimal performance in numerous applications. They are essential in settings where temperature regulation is vital, contributing to the management of processes and the prevention of overheating or freezing. This classification is distinct from other monitoring devices that focus on different electrical parameters, such as voltage, current, frequency, and other physical measurements. The technology employed in these devices can range from simple thermocouples to advanced digital sensors, catering to diverse industrial and commercial needs.

---

## 27371811 — Speed-/standstill monitoring relay

a device designed to detect and report the operational status of machinery by monitoring changes in speed or the absence of movement. This apparatus typically provides alerts or control actions based on predefined thresholds, ensuring optimal performance and safety by preventing potential malfunctions or hazards associated with abnormal speed conditions. It is used in various applications where precise monitoring of operational states is critical, contributing to the overall efficiency and reliability of the system it serves.

---

## 27371813 — Level monitoring relay

a device designed to oversee and manage the levels of various parameters within a system, ensuring that these levels remain within defined thresholds to maintain optimal operational performance. This equipment plays a critical role in safeguarding processes by providing alerts or control actions when monitored levels deviate from preset limits. It is commonly employed in applications where precise level regulation is essential for functionality and safety, facilitating automated responses to prevent potential hazards or equipment malfunctions. This type of relay is integral to low-voltage switch technology, contributing to the overall reliability and efficiency of electrical systems.

---

## 27371814 — Pressure monitoring equipment

devices designed to measure and assess pressure levels within various systems and environments, ensuring operational safety and efficiency. These instruments can provide real-time data and alerts for both normal and abnormal pressure conditions, enabling proactive maintenance and reducing the risk of equipment failure. Typically utilized in industrial and commercial applications, pressure monitoring devices may include various technologies such as digital gauges, analog indicators, and sensors that convert pressure into readable electrical signals. Their use is critical in processes where maintaining specific pressure parameters is essential for functionality and safety, contributing to overall system reliability and performance.

---

## 27371815 — Flow monitoring equipment

devices designed for the assessment and regulation of flow within various systems, ensuring proper operation and safety. This category encompasses a range of instruments that measure the flow rate, detect flow anomalies, and provide feedback for operational adjustments. Flow monitoring equipment is essential in applications where fluid dynamics are critical, contributing to efficiency and safety in processes. These devices may include technologies for measuring flow in liquids or gases and are utilized in numerous sectors, including industrial, environmental, and commercial applications. The equipment is integral for maintaining system integrity and optimizing performance, allowing for timely interventions when flow parameters deviate from expected norms.

---

## 27371817 — Synchronization relay

a synchronization relay is a device designed to ensure that multiple electrical systems or components operate in harmony by matching their timing or phase. This equipment plays a crucial role in applications where precise coordination between different electrical sources is essential, such as in power generation and distribution systems. By detecting phase differences and providing corrective signals, a synchronization relay helps prevent operational disruptions and enhances the reliability of interconnected systems. Its functionality is critical in scenarios that require seamless integration of various power sources, thereby ensuring stable and efficient operation in low-voltage switch technology environments.

---

## 27371819 — Device for monitoring of safety-related circuit

a device designed to oversee and ensure the functionality of safety-related circuits, providing real-time monitoring and alerts for any irregularities or failures. This equipment is crucial for maintaining operational safety in various applications, ensuring that safety protocols are adhered to in environments where electrical circuits are critical. By continuously assessing the integrity and performance of safety circuits, this device plays a vital role in preventing accidents, enhancing reliability, and complying with safety standards. Its operational capabilities may include detecting faults, monitoring circuit conditions, and providing diagnostic feedback to facilitate timely maintenance and intervention.

---

## 27371821 — Two-hand switchgear

a category of devices designed for the manual operation of electrical circuits, specifically allowing for the control and management of electrical flow through a mechanism that requires the use of both hands for activation. These devices are typically utilized in environments where safety and operational integrity are paramount, ensuring that users can engage or disengage electrical connections in a controlled manner. They are essential in applications that necessitate the simultaneous use of both hands to prevent accidental activation and to enhance user safety. This category encompasses a variety of configurations and designs suitable for diverse industrial and commercial applications, ensuring compliance with safety standards while facilitating efficient electrical control.

---

## 27371822 — Stoptime control device

a device designed to control and monitor stoppage conditions within systems, ensuring operational safety and efficiency. This type of control mechanism is integral in applications where the cessation of function needs to be managed precisely, often in conjunction with other monitoring systems. It serves to provide alerts or automatic responses based on predefined criteria, thereby preventing potential hazards associated with unexpected stoppages. Typically used in conjunction with various types of monitoring equipment, this device enhances the overall functionality and reliability of low-voltage electrical systems, contributing to improved operational oversight and safety compliance.

---

## 27371823 — Ripple monitoring equipment

equipment designed specifically for the assessment, tracking, and analysis of ripple effects in electrical systems. This type of apparatus is critical for ensuring the stability and reliability of low-voltage switch technology by detecting variations and fluctuations that may impact performance. By providing real-time monitoring and feedback, it enables users to maintain optimal operational conditions and mitigate potential disruptions. Ideal for a range of applications, this equipment serves as an essential tool for engineers and technicians tasked with overseeing the integrity of electrical systems, ensuring compliance with safety standards, and enhancing overall system efficiency.

---

## 27371824 — Power direction relay

a device designed to control and manage the direction of electrical power within low-voltage systems. This apparatus typically operates by receiving input signals that dictate the desired flow of electricity, ensuring that power is directed appropriately to various components or circuits. The device enhances system reliability by providing protective measures against potential faults or incorrect configurations. Its applications are crucial in automation and control processes, where precise management of electrical energy is essential. The functionalities may include monitoring operational parameters, executing control commands, and integrating with broader monitoring systems to ensure optimal performance and safety in electrical installations.

## 27420102 — Filter circuit coil for low-voltage

a component designed specifically to regulate and filter electrical signals in low-voltage applications, this device utilizes inductive properties to manage current flow and reduce electromagnetic interference. It is engineered to enhance the performance of electronic circuits by stabilizing voltage levels and minimizing noise, ensuring efficient operation. This type of coil is distinct from other inductive components that serve different purposes, such as those designed for common mode or normal mode applications, air core configurations, line or motor/load side applications, and DC link environments. Its primary function is to provide a reliable solution for signal integrity and performance optimization in low-voltage electronic systems.

---

## 27420103 — Common mode choke coil

a common mode choke coil is an electronic component designed to suppress high-frequency noise in electrical circuits. It consists of two or more coils wound on a magnetic core, which allows it to filter out unwanted common mode signals while enabling differential signals to pass through with minimal attenuation. This type of choke is particularly effective in applications where electromagnetic interference (EMI) is a concern, making it ideal for use in power supplies, communication lines, and various electronic devices. By attenuating noise that may affect signal integrity, the common mode choke coil plays a crucial role in enhancing the performance and reliability of electronic systems.

---

## 27420104 — Normal mode choke coil

a component designed to limit current fluctuations and stabilize voltage in electronic circuits by utilizing inductance. This device operates in a normal mode, effectively filtering out electromagnetic interference and providing smooth operation in various electrical applications. It is characterized by its construction and operational principles, which distinguish it from other similar components that serve different functions or applications within electronic systems. The design and performance metrics of this device cater to specific operational requirements in electronic circuits, ensuring reliability and efficiency in energy management.

---

## 27420105 — Air core inductor

a specific type of electrical component designed to store energy in a magnetic field when electrical current flows through it. This component is characterized by its construction, which typically involves a coil wound around an air core, allowing for efficient inductance without the use of a ferromagnetic core. It is primarily utilized in electronic circuits to manage current flow, reduce electrical noise, and improve the performance of power supply systems. This component is distinct from other inductive devices that may utilize different core materials or serve different functions within electronic applications. Its design and functionality make it suitable for various applications in electronic devices, enhancing signal integrity and stability.

---

## 27420106 — Line choke coil

Choke coil to limit circuit feedback on permissible values

---

## 27420107 — Motor/load side choke coil

Choke coil to reduce voltage loadon motor coils

---

## 27420108 — DC link choke

Choke coil to limit voltage load on permissible values

---

## 27420202 — Band pass filter

a device designed to allow signals within a specific frequency range to pass through while attenuating frequencies outside this range. It is commonly used in various electronic applications to enhance signal quality by reducing noise and interference. This type of filter can be characterized by its cutoff frequencies, which define the range of frequencies that are permitted to pass, and its roll-off characteristics, which describe how quickly the filter attenuates signals outside the designated band. Band pass filters are essential components in communication systems, audio processing, and instrumentation, facilitating the selective transmission of signals for improved performance and accuracy.

---

## 27420203 — High pass filter

a high pass filter is an electronic component designed to allow signals with a frequency higher than a certain cutoff frequency to pass through while attenuating frequencies lower than this threshold. This type of filter is commonly used in various applications, including audio processing, telecommunications, and signal processing, to remove unwanted low-frequency noise or interference from a signal. High pass filters can be implemented using passive components like capacitors and resistors or active components like operational amplifiers, depending on the specific requirements of the application. The performance of a high pass filter is characterized by its cutoff frequency, roll-off rate, and phase response, which influence how effectively it separates high-frequency signals from low-frequency ones.

---

## 27420204 — Low pass filter

a low pass filter is a device or component that allows signals with a frequency lower than a certain cutoff frequency to pass through while attenuating frequencies higher than this threshold. It is commonly used in various electronic applications to eliminate high-frequency noise from signals, ensuring that only the desired lower frequencies are transmitted or processed. This type of filter is essential in audio processing, signal conditioning, and data acquisition systems, where the preservation of low-frequency components is critical for accurate signal representation and analysis. The design and implementation of a low pass filter can vary, utilizing passive or active components, depending on the specific requirements of the application.

---

## 27420205 — Band elimination filter

a specialized device that selectively attenuates a specific range of frequencies while allowing frequencies outside this range to pass with minimal loss. It is designed to eliminate unwanted frequency bands from a signal, enhancing the quality and clarity of the output. This type of filter is used in various applications, including audio processing, telecommunications, and signal conditioning, where precise control over frequency response is essential. By effectively removing interference and noise within a defined frequency range, this device ensures optimal performance of electronic systems and improves overall signal integrity.

---

## 27420206 — All-pass-filter

a device designed to allow signals across a broad frequency range while attenuating unwanted frequencies, ensuring that all frequencies within a specified bandwidth can pass with minimal loss. This type of filter is commonly used in various electronic applications to maintain signal integrity and is characterized by its ability to provide a balanced response across multiple frequency components. It serves as an essential component in both analog and digital systems, enabling the effective processing of complex signals while rejecting noise and interference outside the desired range.

---

## 27420207 — Multi-rate-filter

a device designed to separate or filter multiple frequency ranges from a signal, allowing for the selective passage of certain frequencies while attenuating others. This type of filter is characterized by its ability to manage various rates of signal processing within a single unit, making it suitable for applications where different frequency components need to be handled simultaneously. It contrasts with other filtering devices that focus on specific frequency ranges or types of filtering. This type of filter is commonly utilized in electronic systems to improve signal quality and reduce interference, ensuring optimal performance across a range of operational conditions.

---

## 37010101 — Gate valve (without actuator)

a type of valve designed to control the flow of liquids or gases through a pipeline by means of a movable gate that can be raised or lowered. This specific variant operates without an integrated actuator, relying instead on manual or external mechanisms for operation. It is characterized by its ability to provide a tight seal when closed, effectively preventing leakage. This type of valve is commonly used in various industries, including water treatment, oil and gas, and manufacturing processes, where reliable flow control is essential. Its design facilitates easy maintenance and allows for a range of sizes and materials to accommodate different applications and environmental conditions.

---

## 37010107 — Slide gate for waste

a device designed to control the flow of liquids or gases through an opening by means of a sliding mechanism. This type of apparatus typically features a flat gate that slides into position to block or allow the passage of the medium. It is specifically engineered for applications involving waste management, where durability and resistance to corrosive substances are essential. The design and functionality of this device are distinct from traditional gate valves that operate without an actuator, emphasizing its suitability for automated or remote control operations in waste handling systems. This ensures efficient and reliable operation in various industrial and environmental settings.

---

## 37010201 — Shut-off globe valve

a shut-off valve is a type of valve specifically designed to regulate fluid flow within a piping system by fully opening or closing the passage. Its primary function is to stop the flow of the medium when required, ensuring safety and operational efficiency in various applications. This valve typically features a straightforward design that allows for quick actuation, making it suitable for applications where rapid flow interruption is necessary. Shut-off valves are utilized in a diverse range of industries, from water supply and waste management to oil and gas, and are essential components in ensuring the proper functioning of fluid transport systems. Their construction may vary, but they are commonly designed to withstand high pressure and temperature conditions, providing reliable service over time.

---

## 37010203 — Control globe valve

a control valve is a mechanical device used to regulate the flow of fluids in a system by varying the size of the flow passage. It is designed to respond to control signals and adjust the flow rate or pressure within a pipeline, ensuring the desired operational parameters are maintained. Control valves are essential components in various industrial applications, providing precise control over processes such as heating, cooling, and fluid transport. They can operate using different mechanisms such as pneumatic, electric, or hydraulic actuation, and may include features like positioners and feedback systems to enhance their functionality. The differentiation of control valves from other valve types is based on their specific function in modulating flow rather than merely stopping it or redirecting it.

---

## 37010213 — Multiport Globe Valve

a type of valve designed to control the flow of fluids through multiple ports, allowing for the simultaneous connection and regulation of several pipelines or channels. This device serves to manage the direction and volume of fluid flow, contributing to efficient piping systems. Typically utilized in various industrial applications, it features a spherical body and a movable disc that adjusts the passage of fluid. The multiport globe valve is characterized by its ability to enable flow from multiple inlets to multiple outlets, enhancing operational flexibility. It is distinguished from other valve types, such as those that serve solely to shut off flow or to control flow rate in a single pathway.

---

## 37010260 — Bottom globe valve

a valve design characterized by a spherical body shape, which features a movable disk or plug that is positioned within the valve to regulate the flow of fluids. This type of valve is specifically configured to provide a reliable means of controlling flow in various industrial applications. It operates by raising or lowering the disk to either open or close the passageway, thus enabling or restricting fluid movement. The construction typically allows for a tight seal, ensuring minimal leakage when in the closed position. This type of valve is distinct from other valve types that serve different functions, such as those designed primarily for shut-off or control purposes, and is utilized in a variety of settings, including manufacturing and plumbing systems.

---

## 37010265 — Hydrant

a type of device designed for the control and management of water flow in various systems, primarily utilized for fire protection and emergency response. This apparatus typically features a connection point for hoses or other firefighting equipment and is installed to facilitate rapid access to water sources. It is characterized by its ability to withstand high pressures and environmental conditions, ensuring reliable operation when needed. The design may include features that allow for easy operation and maintenance, promoting effective use in critical situations. This classification is distinct from other valve types that serve different functions in fluid control and distribution systems.

---

## 37010269 — Valve block

a valve block is a component designed to regulate the flow of fluids within a system. It typically consists of multiple interconnected valves housed in a single block, allowing for streamlined control and management of fluid pathways. This assembly is often used in industrial applications, where precise flow control, space efficiency, and ease of maintenance are critical. Valve blocks can facilitate various functions, such as directing flow, isolating sections of a system, or combining several flow control mechanisms into one unit. They are distinct from other types of valves, focusing on the integration of multiple functionalities within a compact design, suitable for applications requiring coordinated control of fluid dynamics.

---

## 37010270 — Main stop valve

a device designed to regulate the flow of fluids within a piping system by providing a means to open or close the flow path. This type of valve is characterized by its spherical body shape, which contains a movable plug that can be adjusted to vary the flow rate. It is typically used in applications where precise control over fluid movement is essential, allowing for effective management of pressure and flow in various industrial and commercial settings. The design of this valve facilitates ease of maintenance and operation, contributing to the overall efficiency and safety of fluid handling processes.

---

## 37010401 — Ball tap

a type of valve designed to control the flow of fluids by means of a spherical closure element that rotates within the valve body. This device features a hollow ball that is pivoted within the valve housing, allowing for a straightforward mechanism to either block or permit passage through the valve. The design typically includes an inlet and outlet, providing a reliable and efficient means of flow regulation. This type of valve is distinct from other valve types that may utilize different mechanisms, configurations, or functional characteristics, ensuring specific applications are met with the appropriate flow control solution. Ideal for a variety of industrial and commercial uses, this type of valve is recognized for its durability and ease of operation.

---

## 37010405 — Multiport Ball Valve

a multiport ball valve is a type of valve that features multiple ports, allowing for the control and diversion of fluid flow in various directions. It is designed to regulate the flow of liquids or gases through its spherical closure element, which rotates within a hollowed-out section of the valve body. This rotation opens or closes the valve, enabling or obstructing flow as needed. The multiport design provides enhanced versatility in applications where multiple flow paths are required, differentiating it from other valve types that serve more specific functions. Suitable for a range of industrial applications, this valve is often used in systems that require efficient flow management and space-saving configurations. Its robust construction ensures reliability and longevity in demanding environments.

---

## 37010416 — Plug valve

a type of valve characterized by a cylindrical or tapered plug that can be rotated within a housing to control the flow of fluids. This mechanism allows for smooth operation and a tight seal, effectively stopping or allowing the passage of liquids or gases. Typically utilized in various industrial applications, this valve is distinguished by its ability to provide precise flow control and is commonly employed in systems requiring reliable shut-off capabilities. The design may vary in terms of materials and specifications to suit different operational environments and pressure requirements.

---

## 37010417 — Multiport Plug Valve

a multiport plug valve is a type of valve that allows for the control of fluid flow through multiple ports within a single device. Designed with a rotating plug that contains one or more passages, this valve provides efficient flow regulation and the ability to redirect fluid to different outlets. It is characterized by its straightforward operation, typically requiring a quarter-turn to open or close. The multiport design enhances versatility, making it suitable for various applications where multiple flow paths are necessary. It is characterized by its lack of any openings or bolt holes, serving primarily as a closure for unused ports or ends in piping and equipment. This type of flange is typically used in applications where it is necessary to isolate sections of a system or to serve as a point of future attachment. The blank flange is an essential component in maintaining the integrity and safety of piping systems, ensuring that there are no leaks or escapes of materials under pressure. Its robust steel construction provides durability and strength, making it suitable for various industrial applications.

## 37020204 — Weld-neck collar (steel)

The weld-neck collar is designed to withstand high pressure and temperature conditions, making it suitable for various industrial applications. It is distinct from other flange types in its specific structural configuration and is engineered to maintain the integrity of the joint under demanding operational requirements. This classification encompasses various dimensions and specifications, ensuring compatibility with a range of piping systems.

This classification is distinct from other flange types that utilize welding or other joining methods, focusing specifically on the threaded design for enhanced versatility in applications where frequent disconnection might be necessary. ## 37200101 — Straight tube fitting (metal)

a type of connector designed to join two straight sections of tubing, typically made from metal materials, ensuring a secure and leak-proof connection. This fitting is characterized by its straightforward design, allowing for direct attachment without the need for additional angles or turns. It is commonly used in various applications, such as plumbing, hydraulic systems, and industrial piping, where a seamless flow of fluids or gases is required. Its robust construction offers durability and resistance to pressure, making it suitable for challenging environments. This fitting type is distinct from other variations that incorporate bends, swivels, or additional components to facilitate different connection needs.

---

## 37200104 — Swivel screw fitting (metal)

a type of mechanical component designed for connecting two or more pipes or tubes in a manner that allows for rotational movement, typically constructed from metal. This fitting features a swivel mechanism that enables the connected sections to pivot relative to each other, facilitating flexibility in installation and use. It is distinguished from other types of tube fittings by its ability to accommodate angular adjustments while maintaining a secure seal, thus preventing leaks and ensuring the integrity of fluid or gas flow within a system. This fitting is commonly utilized in various industrial applications where movement and alignment are necessary.

---

## 37200105 — Elbow tube fitting (metal)

a type of connection component specifically designed for joining two sections of tubing at an angle, typically used in various piping and fluid transfer applications. This fitting is characterized by its curved design, allowing for directional changes in the flow path of liquids and gases. Manufactured from metal, it ensures durability and high resistance to pressure and temperature variations. The elbow fitting is essential in creating efficient flow systems while minimizing the risk of leaks and maintaining structural integrity. Its versatile applications span across multiple industries, including plumbing, hydraulic systems, and manufacturing, facilitating effective transportation of fluids in complex piping layouts.

---

## 37200106 — Tee tube fitting (metal)

a type of mechanical connection designed to join metallic tubes or pipes, facilitating the transition or connection between different sections of piping systems. This fitting typically features a T-shape, allowing for the branching of flow in multiple directions. It is engineered to ensure a secure and leak-proof seal, accommodating varying pressures and temperatures. The design may include threaded, welded, or flanged ends for compatibility with various pipe configurations. Used in a wide range of applications, this fitting is essential for efficient fluid or gas transfer in industrial, commercial, and residential settings.

---

## 37200107 — Cross fitting (metal)

a cross fitting made of metal is a type of connector designed to join multiple tubes or pipes at right angles, facilitating the flow of fluids or gases in various directions. This component typically features four openings, allowing for the connection of two pairs of tubes, and is utilized in a variety of applications where versatility in routing is necessary. The design ensures secure and leak-proof connections, often relying on threading or welding for assembly. Cross fittings are commonly employed in plumbing, hydraulic systems, and industrial applications, where the efficient distribution of substances is essential. The material properties of metal provide durability and resistance to pressure and temperature variations, making these fittings suitable for demanding environments.

---

## 37200109 — Straight bulkhead fitting (metal)

a type of mechanical component designed for the secure connection of piping systems, specifically characterized by a cylindrical body that allows for the direct attachment of pipes or tubes without any angular deviation. This fitting is typically made from metal, ensuring durability and resistance to various environmental conditions. Its design facilitates a straightforward and efficient flow of fluids or gases, making it suitable for a wide range of industrial applications. Unlike other fittings, this variant maintains a linear alignment between connected pipes, providing a reliable solution for applications requiring a straight-through connection.

---

## 37200110 — Reducing tube fitting (metal)

a type of mechanical component designed to connect metal tubes while reducing the diameter of the flow path. This fitting facilitates the transition from a larger to a smaller tube, ensuring a secure and leak-proof connection. Typically constructed from durable metal materials, it is used in a variety of applications where fluid or gas transfer occurs, providing essential functionality in systems requiring pressure maintenance and flow control. The design of this fitting allows for effective integration into piping systems, and it is essential for optimizing space and ensuring compatibility between different tube sizes.

---

## 37200111 — Flange fitting (metal)

a specialized component designed to connect sections of piping or tubing, featuring a flat, round surface with holes for securing to other fittings or surfaces. This item is typically manufactured from metal, ensuring durability and strength for high-pressure applications. It serves as a critical junction in various industrial and engineering contexts, providing a reliable means to facilitate the flow of fluids or gases through connected pipes while allowing for efficient assembly and disassembly. The design may vary based on specific pressure ratings, sizes, and connection methods, thereby accommodating a range of operational needs in mechanical and plumbing systems.

---

## 37200112 — Tube end reducer (metal)

a tube end reducer is a fitting designed to connect two sections of tubing with differing diameters, allowing for a seamless transition from a larger to a smaller tube. Constructed from metal, this component is characterized by its ability to facilitate fluid or gas flow while maintaining pressure and integrity within a piping system. The design typically features a tapered or stepped configuration that ensures a secure fit and reduces the risk of leaks. This type of fitting is essential in various applications, including plumbing, industrial processes, and mechanical systems, where space constraints and specific flow requirements necessitate the use of reducers to optimize performance and efficiency.

---

## 37200113 — Tube connector (metal)

a tube connector made from metal is a mechanical component designed to join two or more sections of tubing or piping, facilitating the flow of fluids or gases. This type of connector is characterized by its robustness and durability, making it suitable for various industrial applications. It serves as an essential part of fluid system assemblies, ensuring secure and leak-proof connections. The design may vary to accommodate different configurations and requirements, providing versatility in installation. This classification encompasses various forms of tube connectors that differ in function and design from other types of tube fittings, allowing for a comprehensive understanding of their specific applications and uses in system integration.

---

## 37200114 — Welding tube fitting (metal)

a type of mechanical component designed to connect sections of metal tubing in welding applications. This fitting is specifically engineered to accommodate the unique requirements of welding processes, ensuring secure and reliable joints between pipes or tubes. It typically features a design that allows for the attachment of tubes at various angles or configurations, optimizing flow and structural integrity. The fitting is crafted from durable metal materials to withstand high temperatures and pressures commonly encountered in welding environments. It plays a crucial role in maintaining the efficiency and safety of piping systems.

---

## 37210101 — Axial expansion joint

a component designed to accommodate axial movement in piping systems, typically made from materials such as metal or plastic. This type of joint allows for the expansion and contraction of pipes due to temperature variations, thereby preventing stress and potential damage to the piping structure. It is specifically engineered to facilitate linear displacement while maintaining a secure and leak-proof connection. The design may incorporate features such as flexible materials or specific geometries to enhance performance and durability. This component plays a critical role in ensuring the longevity and efficiency of piping systems in various applications, distinguishing it from other types of expansion joints that address different movement or alignment needs.

---

## 37210102 — Angular expansion joint

a type of flexible connector designed to accommodate angular movements between two sections of piping or ductwork, ensuring the integrity of the system while allowing for thermal expansion, contraction, and slight misalignments. This connector is typically constructed from materials that provide durability and resistance to environmental factors, and it is engineered to maintain a tight seal to prevent leakage. Its design allows for angular displacement, facilitating the adjustment of angles between connected pipes, thereby enhancing the overall flexibility and resilience of the piping system. This component is essential in applications where directional changes or shifts in alignment occur, ensuring smooth operation and longevity of the infrastructure.

---

## 37210103 — Lateral expansion joint

a lateral expansion joint is a mechanical device designed to accommodate lateral movement and thermal expansion in piping systems, particularly those constructed from metal or plastic materials. It serves to absorb the stresses caused by misalignment, thermal fluctuations, and vibrations, ensuring the integrity and longevity of the piping infrastructure. This type of joint is specifically engineered to facilitate movement in a horizontal plane, thereby preventing damage to connected components and maintaining the overall efficiency of fluid transport. Lateral expansion joints are commonly utilized in various industrial applications, where flexibility and adaptability to changing conditions are essential for optimal performance.

---

## 37210104 — Corrugated bellow

a flexible component designed to absorb movement and vibrations in piping systems, typically constructed from layered materials that provide structural integrity while allowing for expansion and contraction. This item is specifically engineered to accommodate changes in alignment and thermal expansion, ensuring the integrity and functionality of the piping system. It is utilized in various industrial applications where the movement of pipes is expected, contributing to the overall efficiency and longevity of the system by reducing stress on connections and preventing leakage.

---

## 37210105 — Universal expansion joint

a flexible mechanical device designed to accommodate movement and thermal expansion in piping systems. This component allows for the absorption of dimensional changes due to temperature variations, pressure fluctuations, or vibrations. It is constructed from materials suitable for various applications, ensuring compatibility with different types of fluids and environments. The design enables it to connect two sections of pipe while permitting relative motion between them, thus reducing stress on the piping system and preventing damage. This type of joint is versatile and can be used in a wide range of industrial and commercial applications.

---

## 37220101 — Pipe (pre-insulated)

a type of tubular product designed for the transportation of fluids or gases, characterized by an insulating layer that enhances thermal efficiency and reduces energy loss. This product is specifically engineered for use in pipeline systems where maintaining the temperature of the conveyed substance is crucial. The pre-insulated feature distinguishes it from other related items by providing additional protection and insulation, ensuring optimal performance in various environmental conditions. This classification excludes items designed for connection or alteration of flow within the pipeline system, focusing solely on the linear elements used to facilitate the movement of materials.

Unlike standard piping, this fitting incorporates specialized design features that enhance thermal performance and installation flexibility. The construction materials are chosen to withstand environmental conditions and pressure variations, ensuring durability and reliability in a range of applications.

## 43020107 — Micro lens (optical component)

## 43020203 — Dove prism (optical component)
